title: AgentEnvelope
description: v2.0.0 — Universal message wrapper for BibleFi agent communications. Includes routing, security context, Farcaster frame context, and Base chain transaction context. Supports the full agentic scripture-pipeline including task orchestration, run logging, seed batches, and multi-language and theological validation.

envelope_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this envelope (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the AgentEnvelope schema used (e.g. '2.0.0').

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the envelope was created.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the envelope should be considered expired.

payload_type.description: Discriminator indicating which schema governs the contents of the 'payload' field. Payload structure validation is the responsibility of the consumer using the appropriate per-type schema.

payload.description: The actual data payload. Must conform to the schema identified by 'payload_type'. Payload validation is out-of-band and performed using the per-type schema. additionalProperties is intentionally true here to allow flexible payload shapes validated by per-type schemas.

sender.description: Identity of the agent or system that produced this envelope.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the sending agent or service.

agent_type.description: Human-readable type label for the sender (e.g. 'scripture-indexer', 'defi-oracle').

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM-compatible wallet address of the sender.

fid.description: Optional Farcaster ID of the sending user or agent.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over the canonical JSON of the payload.

public_key.description: Base64url-encoded public key corresponding to the signing key.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the signature was created.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering, routing, or indexing.

routing.description: Optional message routing metadata for agent-to-agent communications.

destination_agent.description: Target BibleFi agent ID per AGENT_TAXONOMY.md

correlation_id.description: Groups related messages in a conversation/workflow

security_context.description: Optional security classification and trust metadata for the envelope.

trust_level.description: Trust level per BibleFi TRUST_BOUNDARIES.md. All agent communications are sandboxed per SANDBOXING_POLICY.md

sandboxed.description: Whether this envelope originates from a sandboxed agent per SANDBOXING_POLICY.md in Biblefi/BibleFi

farcaster_context.description: Present when envelope originates from a Farcaster Frame interaction. BibleFi is a native Farcaster mini-app.

base_chain_context.description: Present when envelope relates to a Base chain transaction. BibleFi primary chain = Base mainnet (chain_id: 8453).
